title: Combining the Payout-Limit Multipliers of a Northloop Payments Scheduled Payout
content:
**Rule.** The payout limit of a Northloop Payments scheduled payout is scaled by the combined payout-limit multiplier: the scaled payout limit is the plan's maximum per payout times the combined payout-limit multiplier, rounded to the cent. The new-bank, standing, account-age and fulfillment payout-limit multipliers combine into one as follows: when the seller's current level is Preferred Partner Level and no chargeback was debited to the account in the last twelve months, the new-bank payout-limit multiplier times the largest of the other three is the combined payout-limit multiplier; when at least one chargeback was debited to the account in the last six months, the four are multiplied together; otherwise the smallest of the four is the combined payout-limit multiplier.

A window of the last twelve months, or of the last six months, takes in the ledger entries dated after the same calendar day twelve, or six, months before the payout date, up to and including the payout date.

## Combination by condition

| Condition, read in this order | Combined payout-limit multiplier |
|---|---|
| current level Preferred Partner Level and no chargeback debited in the last twelve months | the new-bank multiplier times the largest of the standing, account-age and fulfillment multipliers |
| at least one chargeback debited in the last six months | the product of all four multipliers |
| any other case | the smallest of the four multipliers |

The chargebacks counted are the chargeback debits booked on the Northloop Payments ledger of the account in the window.

## Hypothetical worked example (maximum per payout 50000.00 USD)

Multipliers taken as given: new-bank 0.10, standing 0.8, account-age 0.6, fulfillment 1.25.

- *One chargeback debited four months before the payout date.* The four are multiplied: 0.10 times 0.8 times 0.6 times 1.25 is 0.06; the scaled payout limit is 50000.00 times 0.06, that is 3000.00 USD.
- *No chargeback in twelve months, level not Preferred Partner Level.* The smallest of the four is 0.10; the scaled payout limit is 5000.00 USD.
- *Preferred Partner Level, no chargeback in twelve months, multipliers new-bank 1, standing 1.5, account-age 0.6, fulfillment 1.25.* The new-bank multiplier 1 times the largest of 1.5, 0.6 and 1.25 gives 1.5; the scaled payout limit is 75000.00 USD.
- *Preferred Partner Level, last chargeback debited nine months before the payout date.* A chargeback lies in the twelve-month window but none in the six-month window, so the smallest of the four applies.
